CONTEXT_FEATURE_MANIFEST.observation_timestamp: current Macro decision; before the current Macro action
CONTEXT_FEATURE_MANIFEST.normalization: sum of top-three probability masses, fixed range [0,1]

CONTEXT_FEATURE_MANIFEST.physical_meaning: mean adjacent-horizon change in predicted service-demand composition
CONTEXT_FEATURE_MANIFEST.source_field_or_function: predicted_service_popularity horizon 0..4 in popularity_slice plus prediction_horizon_mask_slice
CONTEXT_FEATURE_MANIFEST.observation_timestamp: current Macro decision; before the current Macro action

CONTEXT_FEATURE_MANIFEST.reason: The offline trace contract does not expose an active-vehicle count field; predicted position coordinates alone do not supply a per-vehicle validity count.
No current task/request count is stored in the selected trace fields or the formal 400D observation schema.
The formal popularity input is a normalized composition; no absolute demand-intensity predictor output is saved in the observation.
The saved observation contains prediction point values and horizon masks, not predictor uncertainty.
No separate current load summary is present in the selected trace fields or formal observation schema.

CONTEXT_PROVENANCE_GATE.feature_selection_rule: One physically motivated, prespecified set of direct current-time and popularity-summary features; no held-out result is used for feature selection.
CONTEXT_PROVENANCE_GATE.prediction_source_causality: The popularity horizons are predictor outputs already present in the current 400D observation; no realized future transition is read to make a feature.

DATA_AND_TARGET_VALIDATION.context_extraction: 2*x observation sources remain raw for deterministic summaries; only state-model input is transformed to 2*x-1

PART_A_CONTEXT_DOMAIN_STRUCTURE.part_a_context_distance_uses: fixed [0,1] physical normalization of frozen context features
PART_A_CONTEXT_DOMAIN_STRUCTURE.standardized_centroid_distance_uses: descriptive E1-E6 global z-score; never reused in Part B

normalized_time_to_go.risk_rule: YES if mean within-episode SD / across-episode centroid SD < 0.10 and between-episode centroid SD > 0.02; descriptive flag only

h0_popularity_entropy_normalized.risk_rule: YES if mean within-episode SD / across-episode centroid SD < 0.10 and between-episode centroid SD > 0.02; descriptive flag only

h0_popularity_top1_mass.risk_rule: YES if mean within-episode SD / across-episode centroid SD < 0.10 and between-episode centroid SD > 0.02; descriptive flag only

h0_popularity_top3_mass.risk_rule: YES if mean within-episode SD / across-episode centroid SD < 0.10 and between-episode centroid SD > 0.02; descriptive flag only

predicted_popularity_horizon_mean_total_.risk_rule: YES if mean within-episode SD / across-episode centroid SD < 0.10 and between-episode centroid SD > 0.02; descriptive flag only

PART_A_CONTEXT_DOMAIN_STRUCTURE.correlation_interpretation_rule: YES only if both Pearson r and Spearman rho are at least 0.5; Part A is descriptive and cannot support missing-state-information by itself

PART_B_STRICT_LOO.protocol: six leave-one-realization-out folds; each fold trains on five episodes only
PART_B_STRICT_LOO.target_normalization: fixed transition-weighted mu_y/sigma_y over five train realizations; heldout excluded
PART_B_STRICT_LOO.context_normalization: per fold train-only mean/std; train-fold constant feature normalized to zero

DECISION_EVIDENCE.minimum_fold_behavior_interpretation: Both minima are reported alongside the majority-fold rule to expose any held-out realization with a large regression; no single-fold metric is hidden by the mean.

rules.improvement: at least 4/6 folds improve and mean and median paired Corr deltas are positive, for both vs State-only and vs State+ZeroContext
rules.macro_train: mean Macro Train Corr no worse than State-only by more than 0.1 and at least 0.5
rules.external_missing_information: only Class A external observable context can support this; frozen set is Class B only

RECOMMENDED_NEXT_ACTION: The frozen context augmentation does not meet the strict paired LOO complementarity criteria. Continue with deeper representation/conditional-value architecture diagnosis; this does not prove context insufficiency.
